caption: The drawing is rendered in black ink on a light beige background and depicts three views of an arm chair as well as textual information. At the top center is a top-down view of the chair seat, shown as a square with mitred corners. Below this are two orthographic views: the left view is a side profile and the right view is a front elevation of the chair. The chair features a combination of straight and curved lines, with turned vertical posts on each side that end in finial shapes. The seat is rectangular, and the back consists of four horizontal, wavy slats between the posts. The arms are curved, connecting the front posts to the rear posts just above the seat. There is decorative turning on the front stretcher at the bottom and similar detail on the arm supports. The drawing includes handwritten labels in the upper right corner, reading "ARM CHAIR," "BROOKLYN MUSEUM," "EASTERN PARKWAY, BROOKLYN," "AMERICAN GALLERY," and "NO. 35.1039 1-P5."
title: Armchair
